integrity: The 163-shape enumeration uses exact integer arithmetic and is reproducible from the included checker.

scientific_limitations: Proves only the d'=10 case with 10s_2 nonintegral; does not settle d'>=11 or the integral case.

The 2021 extremal-curve paper was only abstract-read and remains a residual risk for weighted-projective-plane subcases.
